Answer: E
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 5) demonstrates an enlarged cardiac silhouette consistent with cardiomegaly and a focal opacity in the right middle lung zone containing surgical clips, which corresponds to the pseudoaneurysm seen on the coronal CT (Figure 1). This combination supports the diagnosis of an iatrogenic pulmonary artery pseudoaneurysm (likely post-surgical given the clips) accompanied by cardiac enlargement.
